tags.name: Trips
tags.description: Record, list and delete the trips of the authenticated user.

tags.name: Travel History
tags.description: Keep a personal log of past rides: create, list and update the travel history records of the authenticated user.

tags.name: Unlock Requests
tags.description: Request a simulated vehicle unlock, inspect its state and retry a QR or manual code. Requests belong to the authenticated user.

tags.name: Problem Reports
tags.description: Report vehicle faults, attach an optional photo and consult personal reports. Reported vehicles enter maintenance; qualifying first-minute rides end without a charge.

put.description: Update the location, vehicle, image, duration and distance of an existing travel history record owned by the authenticated user.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the travel history record

403.description: The userId in the body belongs to another user

404.description: Travel history not found or not owned by the user

get.description: List the authenticated user's requests in newest-first order, optionally filtered by booking. Returns an empty list when none exist.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: Optional account ID; must match the authenticated user

403.description: The userId filter refers to another account

post.description: Create a pending request for a booking of the authenticated user. The server generates a random 6-character accessCode valid for 15 minutes and stores a notification carrying it; creating another request issues a fresh code. Creating the request does not start the ride. Request timestamps and scheduled time are set by the server.

400.description: Invalid method, missing fields or vehicle does not match booking

get.description: Retrieve every trip that belongs to the authenticated user.

post.description: Record a completed trip (route, cost, duration, distance and environmental data) for the authenticated user. The userId in the body must match the authenticated account.

403.description: The resource belongs to another user

get.description: Retrieve all travel history records of the authenticated user.

post.description: Create a new travel history record (location, vehicle, duration and distance) for the authenticated user. The userId in the body must match the authenticated account.

403.description: The userId in the body belongs to another user

get.description: Retrieve reports submitted by the authenticated user, including maintenance status and whether the charge was waived. Returns an empty list when none exist.

post.description: Persist a maintenance incident and mark the vehicle as maintenance so it leaves the available map. If a matching owned booking is in progress and began at most 60 seconds ago, finish it with zero charge and return chargeWaived=true. The incident is queued as pending_maintenance; no external maintenance notification is sent.

201.description: Report saved and vehicle marked for maintenance

400.description: Invalid vehicle ID, category, description, photo or booking/vehicle mismatch

get.summary: Get an unlock request by ID
get.description: Retrieve the pending, unlocked or failed state of a request owned by the authenticated user, including attempts and server timestamps.

patch.summary: Attempt or retry a vehicle unlock
patch.description: Validate QR content weride:vehicle:<id>, or the request's server-generated accessCode for manual unlock. An expired accessCode fails like a wrong one, with errorMessage saying so. A recognized code changes the request to unlocked and starts the reserved booking transactionally; an unrecognized code returns 200 with status failed and permits retry. The server sets actualUnlockTime. Future or expired bookings cannot unlock; this simulation has no camera, IoT command or automatic timed unlock.

409.description: Booking is future, expired, completed or cancelled, or vehicle is in maintenance

404.description: Request, booking or vehicle not found

200.description: Attempt processed; inspect status unlocked or failed and errorMessage

403.description: Request or booking belongs to another user

delete.description: Delete a trip of the authenticated user using its ID.

403.description: The resource belongs to another user

get.summary: Get Travel History by User ID
get.description: Retrieve the travel history records of a specific user. Only the user themselves can query their own records.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: ID of the user whose travel history is requested

403.description: The history belongs to another user

get.summary: Get a problem report by ID
get.description: Retrieve a single maintenance report owned by the authenticated user.

UpdateTravelHistoryResource.description: Data used to update a travel history record. userId must match the authenticated account.

TravelHistoryResource.description: A record of a past ride in the travel history of a user.

CreateUnlockRequestResource.description: Create a pending unlock request for a reserved or in-progress booking owned by the authenticated user. The server takes the scheduled time from the booking.

requestedAt.description: Server timestamp at which the request was created

scheduledUnlockTime.description: Booking's scheduled start, or the creation time for an immediate booking

actualUnlockTime.description: Server timestamp of successful unlock; null until unlocked

location.description: Compatibility field; always null because no location telemetry is collected

unlockCode.description: Code submitted on the latest attempt; empty before the first attempt

errorMessage.description: Reason for a failed code; null when no code error exists

accessCode.description: Server-generated 6-character code the owner types for manual unlock; null on requests created before codes existed

codeExpiresAt.description: Instant after which accessCode is rejected: 15 minutes after the request, or after the scheduled start if that is later

UnlockRequestResource.description: Persisted simulated unlock state, with server timestamps and attempt count. A failed code can be retried.

CreateTripCommandResource.description: Data required to record a trip. userId must match the authenticated account.

TripResource.description: A recorded trip with its route, metrics, costs and environmental data.

CreateTravelHistoryResource.description: Data required to create a travel history record. userId must match the authenticated account.

bookingId.description: Required booking UUID; must be owned by the caller, match the vehicle and be reserved, in progress or completed within the last hour

categories.description: At least one category: mechanical, tires, gps, battery, lock, other, brakes or damage

items.description: At least one category: mechanical, tires, gps, battery, lock, other, brakes or damage

description.description: Description up to 2000 characters; may be empty

photo.description: Optional JPEG, PNG or WebP data URL with base64 content, up to 1 MB decoded

CreateProblemReportResource.description: Vehicle fault report. User and report timestamp are taken from the authenticated session and server.

bookingId.description: Related owned booking UUID; null for a report without a booking

categories.description: Selected incident categories: mechanical, tires, gps, battery, lock, other, brakes or damage

items.description: Selected incident categories: mechanical, tires, gps, battery, lock, other, brakes or damage

description.description: User-provided description with surrounding whitespace removed

photo.description: Optional JPEG, PNG or WebP base64 data URL, with at most 1 MB decoded content

status.description: Maintenance queue status; no external maintenance service is notified

reportDate.description: Server timestamp at which the report was saved

chargeWaived.description: True if the related in-progress ride began at most 60 seconds before reporting and was completed with zero charge

ProblemReport.description: Personal vehicle incident queued for maintenance, including the optional photo and first-minute charge-waiver result.

method.description: Method used to interpret the submitted code

unlockCode.description: QR content weride:vehicle:<id>, or the accessCode of the unlock request for manual unlock. Manual comparison ignores case and surrounding spaces.

AttemptUnlockCommand.description: Code submitted for a simulated unlock attempt. Status, attempt count and timestamps are controlled by the server.

ProblemReportSummary.description: Problem report as listed: same as the detail but without the base64 photo; fetch GET /{id} for it.
